text:
Zoe: docs-bot flagged a stale inline example in guides/deploy.md — the snippet references an old CLI flag `--fast-start` that no longer exists. Link: https://internal-ks.docs/guides/deploy.md :eyes:

docs-bot: automated-scan: found 1 stale inline snippet in `guides/deploy.md` (line ~112). Suggested fix: update example to use `--start-mode=fast` or remove. See scan: https://scans.internal/reports/1755554321

maria: thanks for the ping — I maintain the deploy guide. I can take this, quick question: do we prefer keeping the example and swapping the flag, or replacing with the higher-level config snippet?

Zoe: i'd prefer swapping the flag for parity with the CLI change, and add a short note that older flags were renamed. super small PR.

jamal: @maria if you want me to do a quick PR I can. I already have a local branch with some other tiny docs tweaks. Won't take long.

maria: if you have the branch, please go ahead, thanks! Add yourself as author in frontmatter change if you touch it. Also add an inline note: "CLI flag renamed in v0.12" so it shows up in search.

sam: quick reminder — if you update the snippet, please run `yarn docs:build` and sanity-check the generated HTML; link anchors for that section broke last week.

jamal: noted. I'll run the build and post the PR here. PR will be small: 
```
-    rtx deploy --fast-start
+    rtx deploy --start-mode=fast
```

Zoe: :thumbsup: thanks. If you want to mark ownership, add `owner: "maria"` (or `owner: "jamal"`) to the file frontmatter so the next scan routes to the right person.

jamal: PR posted: https://gh.internal/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 — includes build, frontmatter owner set to "maria", and a tiny changelog entry.

maria: LGTM, approved and merged. Thanks @jamal — closing the scan ticket now.

docs-bot: scan-update: issue 1755554321 marked resolved by PR 4822.

Zoe: lovely, thanks all!"
